latestTerminalSummary:
My Round 30 Opus review is a **pass: all fourteen scores are 9** in both light and dark. This is one model's result, not a joint pass and not council completion. The incoming joint streak is 0/2, and only the parent can pair this with the Round 30 peer report.

| Category | Light | Dark |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | 9 | 9 |
| Responsive visual polish | 9 | 9 |
| Save discoverability and feedback | 9 | 9 |

The review ran against application 42c94eb1 with assets aa7a00afd7a2, confirmed from the live asset URLs on both fixtures. The runtime diff against that commit was empty at entry and exit.

**Why component consistency rose from 8.5:** my Round 29 score rested on the empty states using three different text styles. They now share one: the welcome, empty Starred, empty Shared, query miss and filter miss all use the same 600-weight headline, muted helper and 44px action, spaced 12/12/12px. I measured this in 24 views at all four widths in both real schemes, with no horizontal overflow. The welcome still links to `/new` and Starred to `/search`. Clear search returns to the welcome, and Clear search and filters returns to the full Search grid.

**The three user-reported problems are fixed:**
- **Tag colour badge corners:** the check badge now sits concentric with the cell's rounded corner, with no stray pixels at 5–6× zoom. On the small desktop creation cells it still overlaps about a third of the colour dot; that reads as intentional and is only a refinement.
- **Tag pill spacing:** compact 28px labels sit beside separate 32px buttons on desktop and 44px on phones, with no padding wrapped around them.
- **Mobile Save:** I edited and restored the title (never saving) in all 8 width/scheme pairs. The header now shows the word "Save" with a floppy icon, switches between Saved and Unsaved correctly, and stays sticky at deep scroll. Unlike Round 29, nothing in the header moves when the state changes.

The current Save captures match 42c94/aa7. They show pending, saved and a 503 failure with one warning icon, plain retry text and no "Error:" prefix. These came from the parent's tests; I did not run a save, error or retry myself.

Minor notes, none of which changed a score:
- Activity repeats "Artifact version saved." on every row.
- Add and Settings still label their back link "Library" instead of "Starred".
- In the Stored state panel, "Save state" stays an active filled button even with nothing to save.
- The short landscape Share sheet is tight but works.
- Run Log's tags changed during my session from someone else on the shared fixture; I made no saves, attaches or stars.

**Not inspected visually this round:**
- Phone views of the populated destinations
- Tags at 768 and several width/scheme pairs
- The widget, Versions and lower Stored assets panels
- The Filters, Duplicate and viewer receipt/More menus
- Settings, which I measured but did not view

No physical phone or Safari testing was done. The populated round-30 capture folder had no manifest, so I didn't use it, and the full E2E and Go runs were still in progress, so I didn't count them.

Everything I touched is restored: the editor reloads clean (Saved, Save disabled, no open dialogs). Both of my tabs are closed, and the report is the only file I wrote.

Report: `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-30-opus-followup.md`
